commit.author: Samuel Bharti <samuelbharti.io@gmail.com>
commit.message:
fix: attach the web history of a json search

parse_esearch.list() read querykey and webenv from x$esearch_result,
but the field is esearchresult. The lookup returned NULL, so
entrez_search(retmode = "json", use_history = TRUE) attached a
web_history with no QueryKey and no WebEnv, and gave no warning. Given
that history, entrez_summary() failed with "No esummary records found
in file" and entrez_fetch() with HTTP 400.

Reading the right field fixes that. A reply that lacks either value,
or carries an empty one, now gets the warning the xml path gives and
no history. In the json result, file comes before web_history, as it
does for xml, so both formats parse to the same fields in the same
order. One function raises the warning in all three places that need
it.

Three offline tests in test_errors.r cover a reply with a history,
replies without a usable one, and the match with xml. test_webenv.r
gains a live test that fetches records through a json history.
